publicGates.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=fs.readdirSync('.', {withFileTypes:true}).filter(e=>e.isFile()).map(e=>e.name).sort(); const html=files.filter(f=>/\.html$/i.test(f)); if(html.length!==1) throw new Error('expected exactly one html file, got '+files.join(',')); const allowed=new Set(['spark-eval-plan.md', html[0]]); const extra=files.filter(f=>!allowed.has(f)); if(extra.length) throw new Error('extra files: '+extra.join(',')); const text=fs.readFileSync(html[0],'utf8'); if(!/<style[\s>]/i.test(text)||!/<script[\s>]/i.test(text)) throw new Error('missing inline style/script'); if(/<(script|link)[^>]+(src|href)=/i.test(text)) throw new Error('external asset reference found');"

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readdirSync('.').find(f=>/\.html$/i.test(f)); if(!html) throw new Error('missing html file'); const text=fs.readFileSync(html,'utf8'); const buttonCount=(text.match(/<button\b/gi)||[]).length; if(buttonCount<16) throw new Error('expected at least 16 calculator buttons, got '+buttonCount); for(const digit of '0123456789'){ const digitPattern=new RegExp('(<button[^>]*>'+digit+'<)|((data-digit|value)=.?'+digit+')','i'); if(!digitPattern.test(text)) throw new Error('missing digit '+digit); } for(const label of ['+','-','=']) if(!text.includes(label)) throw new Error('missing operator '+label); if(!/data-op=.?[\u002f]|>\/<|\u00f7/.test(text)) throw new Error('missing division operator'); if(!/data-op=.?\*|>\*<|\u00d7/.test(text)) throw new Error('missing multiplication operator'); if(!/(AC|Clear|C)<|clear/i.test(text)) throw new Error('missing clear control'); if(!/(display|screen|result|output)/i.test(text)) throw new Error('missing display/result surface');"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readdirSync('.').find(f=>/\.html$/i.test(f)); const text=fs.readFileSync(html,'utf8'); const style=(text.match(/<style[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/i)||[])[1]||''; if(style.length<1200) throw new Error('CSS too thin for a professional UI: '+style.length+' chars'); for(const need of ['grid','hover','focus','border-radius','box-shadow']) if(!style.toLowerCase().includes(need)) throw new Error('missing UI polish signal: '+need); if(!/@media|clamp\(|min\(|max\(/i.test(style)) throw new Error('missing responsive sizing signal'); if(/eval\s*\(|new Function/i.test(text)) throw new Error('unsafe expression evaluation'); if(!/addEventListener|onclick|data-/.test(text)) throw new Error('missing interactive event wiring');"

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readdirSync('.').find(f=>/\.html$/i.test(f)); const text=fs.readFileSync(html,'utf8'); if(!/<main[\s>]/i.test(text)) throw new Error('missing semantic main'); if(!/(aria-label|aria-live|role=)/i.test(text)) throw new Error('missing basic aria semantics'); if(!/<meta[^>]+viewport/i.test(text)) throw new Error('missing viewport meta'); if(!/<title>[^<]*(calculator|calc)/i.test(text)) throw new Error('title should identify calculator');"
